title: Northgate Tire Center Bay Work Standard — Repeat Repairs on the Same Wheel
content:
# Repeat flat repairs on the same wheel

**Standard.** On a Northgate Tire Center package, the work charged for a flat repair depends on the count of earlier flat repair entries recorded on the package for the same wheel position as the repair being charged (the most recent flat repair entry recorded on the package), the current repair not counted:

| Earlier flat repair entries on that wheel position | Flat repair work charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the flat repair fee plus the TPMS sensor service kit fee plus the rebalancing fee per tire, because a tire patched again is dismounted with a new sensor seal kit and rebalanced |
| exactly 1 | the flat repair fee plus the TPMS sensor service kit fee |
| none | the flat repair fee alone |

**One entry for the wheel.** On a repeat repair the sensor seal kit and the rebalancing are neither booked as entries of their own nor charged at their own fees: they are part of the one flat repair entry for the wheel, and whatever rate the flat repair charge carries scales them together with the repair fee. This exception governs only that flat repair entry; the make-up of any other entry follows the rule that books it, and any fee that no rule folds into another entry, such as the sensor kits charged when a set is installed, remains a separate entry at its own fee.

**Rounding.** The flat repair charge is worked on the unrounded work charge and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Counting points

- Only flat repair entries on the same wheel position count; repairs on other wheels of the set do not.
- The repair being charged is not itself counted.
- The fee figures are those of the package held: its flat repair fee, its TPMS sensor service kit fee and its rebalancing fee per tire.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees: repair $15.00, sensor kit $5.00, rebalancing $10.00)

| Earlier repairs on the wheel | Work charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | $15.00 |
| 1 | 15.00 plus 5.00: $20.00 |
| 2 | 15.00 plus 5.00 plus 10.00: $30.00 |
| 3 | $30.00 |
